segments.text: MOST BUSINESSES SET IT AND FORGET IT
segments.narration: Most local businesses set up their Google Business Profile once and never return. That is the gap.

Businesses that respond to all reviews receive 35 percent more website clicks than businesses that don't respond. Each response is indexed by Google. Write them like a new customer will read them, because they will.
segments.explanation: Responding to all reviews gives 35 percent more website clicks than not responding

segments.text: POST AT LEAST ONCE EVERY WEEK
segments.narration: Google Business Profile posts expire after 7 days. Post once a month and your profile sits dark for 3 weeks out of 4. Post once a week to keep an update visible. Offers, updates, and product posts all count.
segments.explanation: GBP posts expire after 7 days. Weekly posting maintains a current post visible in your listing

segments.narration: The Q&A section on your GBP is publicly editable. Any user can answer, including incorrectly. Seed it yourself by asking and answering the 5 questions your customers ask most. Use complete sentences and include your service keyword and city naturally once each.
segments.explanation: Any Google user can answer Q&A questions. Seeding your own prevents incorrect community answers from appearing

segments.narration: Photos taken at your business contain GPS coordinates embedded in the file. When you upload those to Google Business Profile, those coordinates reinforce geographic relevance. Shoot photos on-location, not at home. If you edit before uploading, use software that preserves location metadata.
segments.explanation: Photos taken at your business contain GPS coordinates in EXIF data that reinforce geographic relevance for local ranking

segments.text: ADD VIDEO TO YOUR GBP MEDIA TAB
segments.narration: Google Business Profile supports video uploads in the Media tab. Most local competitors have added nothing. A 30-second video of your storefront or a service being performed gives your listing a visual layer that most Map Pack results don't have. Maximum 75 megabytes, 720p minimum, no overlaid text or logos.
segments.explanation: GBP supports video up to 75 MB and 30 seconds. Most local competitors have not added any

segments.narration: 64 percent of consumers use Google to find local business information, according to BrightLocal 2024. That makes Google Business Profile the single highest-priority local marketing channel for any business with a physical location. Everything else runs a distant second.
segments.explanation: 64 percent of consumers use Google to find local business information per BrightLocal 2024

segments.text: RESPOND TO NEGATIVE REVIEWS IN 4 HOURS
segments.narration: Negative reviews sit in plain sight for every future customer who searches your business. Respond within 4 hours. Acknowledge the problem, apologize without excuses, and offer a direct way to resolve it. A professional response to a 1-star review often converts more new customers than the review loses.
segments.explanation: Fast professional responses to negative reviews reduce reputational damage and signal active management to Google

segments.title: GBP Optimization Activities by Local Ranking Impact
segments.narration: Responding to all reviews carries the highest local ranking weight of any ongoing optimization activity. Weekly posts and active Q&A management follow closely. Monthly photo updates provide consistent lift. Adding video gives moderate impact and is heavily under-used by local competitors.
